cases.title: Admin/operator/viewer application deploy and definition permissions
covered: Operator UI hid create/actions/save controls and disabled assigned-node selection; direct create/PUT/DELETE returned 403; definition remained unchanged.
Operator deploy API returned HTTP 200. The associated execution reached SUCCESS; application state reported operation=deploy and health=healthy.
Guest evidence showed the managed unit active, binary installed, and operator config present.
Viewer UI hid create/actions/deploy/save controls; direct create/PUT/DELETE/deploy returned 403 and no execution was created.
The follow-up audit fields and resource evidence were saved.
remaining: Admin-specific deploy/definition-permission path is not established by this evidence set.
The Operator UI feedback portion did not pass: health card still showed '暂无节点健康状态' and execution-history SUCCESS row count was 0 despite successful API execution and healthy Guest state.
Do not promote the overall P14P15-12 case to PASS based only on the successful Operator deployment.
